title: optional-dependency extras with a drift checker
author: Claude-JG
description: there was no way to install the packages needed for the tests or referred to internally; and no mechanism to notice when the code starts importing something that no declared list installs. revision2026 step R2.12
releaseNotes: [project.optional-dependencies] adds tests / all / rl; all built on the PEP 508 self-reference exudyn[tests]. tools/checkExtras.py AST-scans TestModels; exudyn and Examples and fails when an import is installed by no extra; run in CI as check_extras. Verified by fault injection: a fake import; a removed extra entry and a deleted name-mapping entry each reported with exit 1. rl is deliberately not part of all (torch size and the --index-url CUDA choice); confirmed that allExudynModulesTest.py announces the resulting skip rather than passing vacuously
